description: Conditional and illustrative classification threshold profiles. These demonstrate schema and contextual constraints; none are universal or approved for unverified automatic classification.

provenance.mandatory_rule: NEVER treat any threshold profile as a universal constant. Automated classification requires explicit user or regional calibration approval.

profiles.purpose: Landscape fire burn severity classification guidelines (Key & Benson 2006 / USGS)
profiles.sensor_product: Landsat TM/ETM+/OLI Level-2 Surface Reflectance or Sentinel-2 L2A
profiles.calibration_method: Composite Burn Index (CBI) field calibration plots in temperate forest
profiles.validation_metric: R-squared ~ 0.72 vs field CBI in western US forests
caveats: Thresholds are designed for temperate forests; dry rangelands, savannas, and boreal peatlands require different local cutoffs
If using USGS scaled dNBR product, values must be multiplied by 1000 (-100, 100, 270, 440, 660)
Pre- and post-fire imagery must be phenologically matched (anniversary date) to avoid seasonal false positives

profiles.purpose: Demonstrate qualitative optical vegetation ranges. NOT operational classification boundaries.
caveats: NDVI values are heavily influenced by soil background color, moisture, sensor viewing geometry, and atmospheric aerosol residual
DO NOT use fixed 0.2/0.4/0.6 boundaries as automated land cover maps without regional validation and multi-temporal metrics
NDVI does NOT represent percentage cover directly

profiles.purpose: Snow delineation threshold with mandatory NIR brightness co-condition (Hall et al. 1995 / MODIS Snow Product)
profiles.sensor_product: MODIS Surface Reflectance / Landsat OLI / Sentinel-2 L2A
profiles.calibration_method: MODIS Snow team empirical rule: NDSI >= 0.4 AND NIR >= 0.11 (to prevent open water misclassification)
profiles.validation_metric: Snow mapping accuracy > 93% in cloud-free conditions
caveats: Water bodies also have high NDSI (since NDSI formula is identical to MNDWI). The condition NIR >= 0.11 (or NIR >= 0.10) is MANDATORY to separate snow from open water
Thin cirrus clouds and shadows in steep terrain cause errors
